note: The FNS requirement states that for veterans' benefits, if the household denies receipt (negative allegation), the reviewer may accept that statement absent evidence to the contrary. The OLG covers this principle through its general verification framework. The Questionable & Contradictory Information pages (Examples of Questionable & Contradictory Information, Example 2) establish the standard that household statements are accepted when 'the Department has no other information that contradicts what was reported.' The Verification Chart marks veterans' benefits verification as Mandatory only when benefits are reported — the verification obligation is triggered by a positive allegation, not a denial. The Self-Declaration page further establishes that DTA can rely on client attestation for various items. Workers operating under this framework would correctly accept a household's denial of veterans' benefits absent contradictory evidence, consistent with FNS 1032.2.
